source_policy: Transcribes Philco's stated alignment procedure and published receiver targets. No unstated tolerance, generator level, supply test voltage, instrument impedance, or circuit terminal mapping is added.

equipment.requirement: Covers the receiver frequency range; Philco cites models 077 or 177.

equipment.model_reference: Philco models 027 and 028 circuit testers included both meters.

vacuum_tube_voltmeter.negative_lead: Any circuit point where AVC voltage can be obtained.

if_alignment.high_side: Through a 0.1 µF capacitor to the antenna section of the tuning condenser.

rf_alignment.method: Make a loop from a few turns of wire, connect it to the generator output, and place it close to the receiver loop aerial.
rf_alignment.receiver_out_of_cabinet: Place the loop aerial approximately as it is positioned when assembled.

dial_calibration: With the tuning condenser at maximum capacity (plates fully meshed), set the pointer on the small dial dot below 550 kHz.
limitations: The source's chassis-referenced VTVM alignment hookup does not establish that chassis and B-minus are the same node.
The stated AVC measurement point is not mapped to a numbered socket terminal in this record.
Factory voltage labels remain reference data only until their own measurement conditions and return reference are verified.
Alignment instructions do not supply the IF transformer inductance, capacitance, Q, coupling, or RF tuning-gang values required for a full receiver model.

cross_validation.document: Complete Instructions for Adjusting All Philco Receivers, Volume 2
cross_validation.publisher: Philco Radio Historical Society library scan of Philco service instructions
limits: The alignment procedure identifies the high-end oscillator adjustment by trimmer number and frequency; it does not trace the oscillator gang stator, remaining #7–#11 connections, or 7A8 socket pins.
The approximately 15-minute warm-up instruction is a service procedure condition, not a measured PT-44 electrical acceptance limit.
Generator amplitude, operating supply during alignment, meter loading, and voltage tolerances remain unspecified in the available reference.
